title: Markets for Compute and Inference: Structure, Financing, and Risk Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2611.20242v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Capacity to run large language models is rented by the accelerator-hour, and their output is sold by the million tokens. Both goods now have published price indices, an over-the-counter forward has traded on one, a perpetual future on one is listed offshore, and CME and ICE have specified futures on rental indices that await the United States regulator. We ask what in these two markets can be hedged, by whom, and at what price. Three findings stand out. First, the price that exchange contracts settle on is not the price that drives operators' revenue. Every contract references the published short-dated rental rate, while most revenue, and with it credit quality, comes from private multi-year contracts whose prices are largely undisclosed. translated_title: 算力与推理市场：结构、融资与风险转移
translated_abstract: 运行大型语言模型的算力按加速器小时出租，其产出按每百万token计价出售。这两种商品如今都有了公开的价格指数；其中一个指数已有场外远期合约在交易，其中一个的永续期货已在离岸市场上市，且CME和ICE已就租金指数期货合约做出规范，正等待美国监管机构的批准。我们探讨这两个市场中什么可以对冲、由谁对冲、以及以何种价格对冲。有三个发现尤为突出。第一，交易所合约所结算的价格并非驱动运营商收入的价格。每份合约都参考公开的短期租金率，而大部分收入以及与之相伴的信用质量，却来自价格基本不公开的私人多年期合同。第二，token价格与租金率通过吞吐量和利润率由一个恒等式联系起来，但它们是不同的风险敞口，因此对租金率的对冲并不能对冲推理的成本。
tldr: 该论文研究了新兴的算力租赁与推理token市场中的对冲问题，发现交易所合约结算所依据的公开短期租金率与运营商实际收入来源的私人多年期合同价格相互脱节，且租金率与token价格属于不同的风险敞口，因此对租金率进行对冲无法覆盖推理成本的风险。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes hedging in the emerging compute rental and inference token markets, showing that the published short-term rental rates on which exchange contracts settle diverge from the undisclosed private multi-year contract prices that drive operators' revenue, and that rental rates and token prices are distinct exposures, so a hedge on the rental rate does not hedge the cost of inference.
